facts.fact: The civil-society group APSAD presented a report in Libreville finding no transparent mechanism for restricting social media, self-censorship among public-debate actors and rules short of international standards, and urged an end to blanket social-media suspensions and a more independent HAC.
facts.system: APSAD report on civic and digital freedoms

facts.fact: The document describes a temporary suspension of social networks in Gabon and slowed internet speed that hampers journalists, content creators and digital firms, with mass VPN use needed to reach platforms; no ordering body or start date is given beyond the HAC context.
